sources.applicableScope: B01 repository as domain collection boundary; do not impose mandatory custom repository universally.
B01/B02 DDD aggregate/root consistency and repository; guide explicitly allows avoiding custom repositories.
B03 mapper separates object and database concerns; distinguish persistence mapping from domain invariants.
B04 identity scope; not global cache or concurrency guarantee.
B04 tracks work and coordinates persistence; no distributed atomicity claim.
B04 EF DbContext tracking identity and duplicate instances; limit to stated EF semantics.
B02/B04/B08 transaction support depends on provider; SaveChanges default behavior is scoped, not external-effect atomicity.
B05 binary compatibility, reserved deleted field numbers/names, distinctions from ProtoJSON; do not universalize across serialization formats.
B06 DTO transport boundary and assembler; DTO does not grant domain validity.
B06 translation and semantic isolation between systems; use stated external boundary.
B07 explicit lazy/eager/select-in/raise loading semantics; avoid universal loading recommendations.
B08 optimistic concurrency conflict handling/reload or merge; retry is not blind overwrite.
B08 commit acknowledgement failure leaves outcome unknown; retry/idempotency/verification boundary must be explicit.
